text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the final corner, it's a battle
down the stretch! Kitasan Black is running
away with the lead!
But here comes the trailing pack, closing
the gap in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Guy
text_block_list.text: Kita-chaaan! Keep going, hold that lead—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Family Fan
text_block_list.text:
Crown-san! Go, gooo!
Sweep past them! Dia-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I won't—let you go!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Even I... Even I can...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Duramente pulls alongside the lead!
Cheval Grand is biting right at their
heels!
With 200m remaining, the top favorites are
lined up in a dead heat!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will it be Kitasan, Dia, or Crown!?
Duramente, or Cheval!? Breaking away in
front is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the year's final
event-by-event competition is Duramente!
With a razor-sharp late surge from the far
outside, she clinches a glorious 1st
place!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Phew...
Alright...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Ehehe... feels like we really gave it our
all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's just how passionately we ran
through it all.
It was the perfect race to close out the
year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haah... I was so close~! But this made me
realize
how much I'm still lacking, so I've gotta
work even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Guy
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chaaan! That was a front-running run
packed with real guts!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Lady
text_block_list.text:
"My heart was pounding just watching you!
Show us plenty more of your running next
year too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Next time I'll make sure to win and
turn it into a real festival!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, to generate this much enthusiasm and
excitement even in an intramural race...
Kitasan Black, you truly live up to your
reputation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To become the "strongest," it takes not
just strength, but also the power to be
"loved."
If I get another chance, I will also...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"You too, Cheval-kun! Good job out
there~!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? U-Um...
I'm so sorry I couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"No need to apologize, really! Good luck
next time too!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I... I am so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming today,
everyone—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to become an Umamusume
you'll want to cheer for even more!
Now then, so that everyone can have a
wonderful New Year's, ready, set—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!
Display event title logo.

"With the final year-end track and field
meet concluded, the academy entered winter
break.
While most students return home, a few
remain behind..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Tracen Acadeeeemyyyy... *pant*...
Fight-o... *whew*... fight-oooo..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Turbo~, you're going too fast.
Sheesh, going full throttle during
warm-ups?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Turbo is always at full throttle...
y'know!
'Cause the track and gym are totally
empty, so th-th-this is... hummm...?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It's all about 'efficiency,' Turbo-san.
You don't have to wait in line, and you
can run as much as you like without
worrying about anyone around you."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"With most Umamusume gone home for winter
break, the academy is basically all to
ourselves.
It's the perfect time to pull ahead of our
rivals!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Always prioritizing cost-performance and
time-efficiency, as usual~
Well, you have a point, which is why I'm
rolling with it too.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Neicha-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, pops? ...Wait, what's with all those
huge loads in the cart?
It's piled high with carrots, sports
drinks, and even mochi...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text:
Here's some refreshments from everyone at
the shopping district for you girls
working hard through winter break!
Show us some amazing races next year too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~ really?! Whoaaa, talk about a
lifesaver...
Turbo, Royce, change of plans! Help us
carry this stuff!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And that wraps it up...! But man, that's
so much food, I'm worried we can't finish
it all.
Even if we gather all the girls left at
the academy, can we actually clean our
plates...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"How about making something for the folks
in the shopping district to eat too?!
Nature, you paid them back with cooking
before, right!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds lovely. Like expressing
your everyday gratitude.
Deepening your bond with fans and taking a
step toward becoming a beloved Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It is the end of the year, after all.
Gathering everyone to welcome the new year
with a modest party might not be such a
bad idea!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They're getting all hyped up again...
Though I guess ringing in the new year
together while sipping kasujiru has its
own charm.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Query! What is the meaning of this
mountain of luggage?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman, perfect timing!
Could you open up part of the academy to
the public on New Year's Eve?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I received a whole bunch of ingredients,
so I thought it'd be fun to ring in the
New Year together while serving food to
the fans."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What a marvel...! Truly inspiring! An
Umamusume showing such initiative to
express her gratitude to her fans! I am
deeply moved!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, it's really nothing that impressive...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Approved! The academy will provide full
support as well!
Let's make it a wonderful event! I shall
issue the notice at once!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Announcing: The New Year's Countdown
Party!
Let us invite the fans starting New Year's
Eve, and welcome the new year together!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"『Wanted! Performances to entertain the
fans! Food stalls permitted!
Whether as an individual or a group,
anyone wishing to participate, apply to
Tazuna!』"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Let us liven things up, offer great
hospitality,
and ring in the finest New Year together
with our fans!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"'Eeeeek~!! This has gotten way out of
hand—!!'"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Together with the fans...
